data.gender_notes: Munamirah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic root 'n-m-r', meaning 'to protect'. Munamirah is a title given to those who shield and defend their faith and beliefs. The name Munamirah carries the meaning “Protector of the Faith” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Munamirah usually hope their child will grow to embody protector of the faith and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name reflecting one's commitment and dedication to their faith.
data.etymology: Munamirah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Protector of the Faith.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Munamirah total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
